recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, minimalist 1970s-style portrait composition featuring a subject positioned on the far left, looking back toward the camera, set against a vast expanse of off-white negative space with stylized geometric typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left vertical third, creating a strong asymmetrical balance.
The dark, textured green of the jacket contrasts sharply with the flat, warm-white background.
The geometric lines of the typography echo the verticality of the subject's pose.
coreInvariants: Off-white or cream-colored background with subtle paper texture.
Subject looking over the shoulder toward the viewer.
Typography restricted to the top-right corner.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-full shot positioned on the left edge, scaled to occupy approximately 80% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary anchor, followed by the large-scale text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the shoulder down, then moves across the negative space to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the right side, creating a sense of openness and sophistication.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange and teal (Inline typographic details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low-to-mid value subject; saturation is muted to maintain a vintage film look.

letterConstructionRules: Ultra-thin stroke weights for the primary skeleton.
Geometric circles for rounded characters (O, D, R).
Double-line or inline decorative elements on vertical stems.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stems of 'E', 'D', and 'K' feature a secondary parallel line in a contrasting color.
The 'S' has a wide, open geometric curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color-based decorative modifications.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for the 'O' and 'D'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark green velvet blazer and white turtleneck, standing on the left side of the frame looking back over his shoulder. The background must be a flat, textured off-white paper surface with significant empty space on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the display text in the upper right corner using a hairline geometric sans-serif. Add thin vertical accent lines in orange and teal inside the stems of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the subject strictly on the left third?
Is the background a warm, textured cream?
Is the text hairline-thin and geometric?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the subject.
Check that the 'inline' effect on letters is clean and vertical.
Verify the off-white background is not pure white.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed toward the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject[Left-Aligned] + NegativeSpace[Right-Two-Thirds] + Typography[Top-Right, Hairline-Geometric] = 70s Soul Aesthetic
